name: Lagoons of New Caledonia: Reef Diversity and Associated Ecosystems
description: Ringing New Caledonia's main island in the South Pacific, this French territory's reef system is one of the world's three largest. Its barrier reef runs about 1,500 kilometres and encloses a shallow lagoon of some 24,000 square kilometres. Snorkellers and divers find mangroves, seagrass beds, rich coral, big predatory fish, turtles, whales and one of the world's largest dugong populations.
